_doc: Human rulings on company -> SEC-registry links, in the same spirit as
HARD_TICKER_OVERRIDES: this file is the source of truth for names the
matcher gets wrong, and the matcher never writes to it.
A name matcher on financial firms produces three kinds of hit, and only a
RIGHT      the registry entity is the company, or its principal adviser.
AFFILIATE  a real entity in the right corporate family whose figure is a
fraction of the company's. Not blocked here: the tier is
stored on the row and the read path shows the filed entity
name beside the figure, so the reader sees what they are
looking at. Blocking these would throw away correct data.
WRONG      a different company that happens to share a first word. Every
entry below is one of these.
Each blocked entry was adjudicated by reading the registry entity's own
filed name and business against the company the page is about. `matched`
records what the matcher had proposed, so a future change can be tested
against the same evidence rather than rediscovering it.
Keys are matched on the normalized company name (backend/registry/match.py
normalize), so casing and punctuation do not matter.

links.reason: Mercor is an AI talent-marketplace startup. Mercor Investment Group is an unrelated registered adviser. Shared first word only.

links.matched: MERCURY ADVISORY, LLC (CRD 308960, RAUM $17.9B); MERCURY REAL ESTATE ADVISORS LLC (CIK 1264188, last 13F 2009)
links.reason: Mercury is a startup-banking fintech. Neither registered entity is related to it; the 13F filer stopped filing in 2009.

links.matched: RIPPLE EFFECT ASSET MANAGEMENT LP (CRD 331250 / CIK 2031590, RAUM $218.4M)
links.reason: Ripple is the XRP payments company. Ripple Effect Asset Management is an unrelated adviser.
Cresta is an AI contact-centre software startup. Cresta Advisors is an unrelated adviser.
Harvey is a legal-AI startup. Harvey Partners is an unrelated hedge fund.

links.matched: AURELIUS FAMILY OFFICE, LLC (CRD 323016 / CIK 2053738, RAUM $315.3M)
links.reason: The universe row is Aurelius Group, the German turnaround investor (AURELIUS Equity Opportunities); the companies row is named 'Aurelius'. Aurelius Family Office is an unrelated US family office.

B Capital Group is the Saverin/Bhattacharya growth fund, founded 2015. This filer predates it by nine years and stopped filing in 2006. Also excluded by the 13F staleness guard; blocked here so it stays excluded if that guard is ever relaxed.
DST Global is Yuri Milner's fund. This filer stopped in 2014 and its identity is unconfirmed. Also excluded by the staleness guard.
Correct entity, but it stopped filing 13F in 2017, so the existence flag describes 2017 and not today. Also excluded by the staleness guard.

links.matched: NEEDHAM FUNDS INC (CIK 1002537); NEEDHAM & COMPANY, LLC (CRD 16360, RAUM $0.00)
links.reason: The universe row is the investment bank. Needham Funds is the affiliated mutual-fund family, a different legal person whose 13F is about the funds' holdings. The bank's own ADV reports RAUM 0.00 and supplies no figure either.

links.matched: Eldridge Investment Advisors, Inc. (CIK 1727993, state NH)
links.reason: The universe row is Eldridge Industries, the Boehly holding company in Greenwich CT. This filer is a New Hampshire registered adviser with an unrelated name collision.
